item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a lot of structure: meditation, check-ins, a walk, and a few pauses to question your own thinking. Hydration belongs in that structure too. Dehydration quietly worsens focus, mood, and patience, and those are the things you're working to protect. Don't wait for thirst. Tie water to moments you already keep. Your action: drink a full glass of water right now, before your next scheduled item.
